# Ingestion test fixtures

Every file in this directory is synthetic and generated by
`backend/scripts/make_testdata.py`. Nothing here is copied from a real
dataset, and nothing here carries a licence obligation.

The generator is deterministic:

- text fixtures are written as UTF-8 (except `cp1252_non_utf8.csv`, which
  exists to exercise the encoding fallback) with LF newlines;
- the workbook fixtures are rewritten with a fixed ZIP member timestamp, so two
  runs of the generator produce identical bytes;
- `error_cells.xlsx` and `formulas_cached.xlsx` are produced by rewriting one
  cell of `observations.xlsx` at the XML level, because OpenPyXL can neither
  write a spreadsheet error cell nor a cached formula value;
- the Parquet fixtures are written by PyArrow, which is byte-deterministic for
  identical input and the same library version.

`digests.json` records the SHA-256 of every fixture. The test
`test_ingestion_fixture_integrity.py` verifies that the committed files still
match those digests, so a fixture can never drift from the behavior the tests
describe.

## Contents

| Fixture | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `long_observations.csv` | Long layout: one row per station, parameter, and time; includes a censored value (`<0.01`), an empty value, an out-of-range value, and a non-finite value |
| `wide_station_matrix.csv` | Semicolon-delimited, comma-decimal, station-by-time wide matrix |
| `observations.tsv` | Tab-delimited long table |
| `no_header_table.csv` | Data rows without a header, so column names must be positional |
| `cp1252_non_utf8.csv` | Not valid UTF-8; exercises the Windows-1252 fallback and transcoding |
| `malformed_ragged.csv` | A record with one field too many |
| `malformed_unclosed_quote.csv` | An unterminated quoted field |
| `binary_disguised.csv` | Contains NUL bytes; rejected before parsing |
| `empty.csv` | Zero bytes; rejected as an empty table |
| `observations.xlsx` | Two sheets; mixed cell types, two formula cells |
| `formulas_cached.xlsx` | `observations.xlsx` with a cached value written into formula cell `F2` |
| `error_cells.xlsx` | `observations.xlsx` with cell `C2` rewritten as a `#DIV/0!` error cell |
| `not_a_workbook.xlsx` | Plain text with an `.xlsx` name; rejected by the container check |
| `observations.parquet` | Typed columns: string, double, timestamp with UTC, date32, int32, bool, decimal128, string with a null |
| `nested_columns.parquet` | Contains a list column; rejected at column selection |
| `truncated.parquet` | Cut inside the footer; rejected by the Parquet reader |

## Regenerating

```bash
cd backend
.venv/Scripts/python scripts/make_testdata.py          # regenerate (Windows)
.venv/Scripts/python scripts/make_testdata.py --check  # verify the digests
```

CI runs the `--check` form, so an edited fixture without regenerated digests
fails the build.
